scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run sdk:test
scripts.sdk:doctor: uv run --project services/panda-adapter --python python python -m panda_adapter doctor
scripts.sdk:init: uv run --project services/panda-adapter --python python python -m panda_adapter initialize
scripts.sdk:test: uv run --project services/panda-adapter --python python python -m unittest discover -s services/panda-adapter/tests
